scope: Corollary 1.2 of the manuscript “A Counterexample to the Infinite Matroid Packing/Covering Conjecture” (preprints/A-Counterexample-to-the-Infinite-Matroid-Packing-Covering-Conjecture-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 185 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 320eb5d308aabe2d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The same pair (M0, M1) constructed in Theorem 1.1 consists of partitional matroids and does not satisfy intersection. More explicitly, for every set J independent in both M0 and M1 and every partition J = J0 ˙ ∪J1, clM0 (J0) ∪ clM1 (J1) ̸= E. Consequently, the unrestricted infinite Matroid Intersection Conjecture is false in ZFC. The pair also gives a negative ZFC answer to Joó’s Question 1.5 for two partitional matroids on a common countable ground set.
